subject.title: Feature: Slack workspace file injection + global systemPrompt (parity with Telegram)

question: Should OpenClaw add a public Slack account/global `systemPrompt` contract, or should operators use the existing wildcard per-channel prompt plus file-backed include path instead?
rationale: This is not a broken existing contract; it adds new config/API surface in an area where a prior PR was closed as the wrong shape and repo policy sets a high bar for new config knobs.

options.title: Approve narrow account prompt
options.body: Add `channels.slack.systemPrompt` and per-account inheritance only, stack it before per-room overrides, cover DMs/MPIMs/slash commands, and update schema/docs/tests.

options.title: Decline new prompt surface
options.body: Document `channels.slack.channels["*"].systemPrompt` and file-backed prompt includes as the intended solution, then close this issue as product-declined.

options.title: Wait for includeText
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/87771 settle first, then reassess whether file-backed per-channel prompts remove enough of the reported pain.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow account prompt
recommendation.body: Add `channels.slack.systemPrompt` and per-account inheritance only, stack it before per-room overrides, cover DMs/MPIMs/slash commands, and update schema/docs/tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent made the closest prior maintainer decision on the same Slack prompt surface and authored the merged replacement prompt work.
